milestones.title: Day 0: Begin
milestones.message: This is the first brave decision. You do not need to win forever today; you only need to protect this moment.
effects: You have interrupted the smoking routine.
Cravings rise and fall like waves.

milestones.title: Day 1: You started
milestones.message: One day smoke-free. You have already shown that a craving does not control your decision.
effects: Carbon monoxide levels begin moving toward normal.
Your heart and lungs are starting to recover.

milestones.title: Day 2: Keep choosing yourself
milestones.message: Two days complete. Your future gym sessions are being built by choices like this one.
effects: Nicotine is largely out of your body.
Taste and smell may begin to improve.

milestones.title: Day 3: The first big test
milestones.message: Three days is a powerful proof point. When a craving arrives, remember that you have already outlasted it before.
effects: Breathing may begin to feel easier.
Energy may start to improve.

milestones.title: Day 4: Build the new routine
milestones.message: Day four is about repetition. Replace the old smoke break with water, walking, or a few slow breaths.
effects: Your body is adapting to life without new smoke exposure.
Triggers can become easier to recognize and plan for.

milestones.title: Day 5: Craving is not a command
milestones.message: Five days strong. A craving can be uncomfortable without being something you must obey.
effects: Your smoke-free coping skills are getting practice.
Your exercise recovery can benefit from avoiding smoke.

milestones.title: Day 6: Protect tomorrow
milestones.message: You are one day away from a full week. Make the next healthy choice small and immediate.
effects: Your lungs continue their recovery.
Your daily routine is beginning to separate from smoking.

milestones.title: Day 7: One week complete
milestones.message: A full week smoke-free. You have created evidence that you can change a difficult habit.
effects: Many people begin noticing fewer smoking triggers.
Walking and training may start to feel more comfortable.

milestones.title: Day 8: Momentum
milestones.message: The first week is behind you. Today is not starting over; it is continuing your progress.
effects: Your body keeps repairing itself without new smoke.
Your confidence grows each time you handle a trigger smoke-free.

milestones.title: Day 9: Choose your lungs
milestones.message: Nine days complete. Your next workout deserves the cleanest breathing you can give it.
effects: Circulation continues to improve over time.
Physical activity may feel more manageable.

milestones.title: Day 10: Ten decisions
milestones.message: Ten days means ten days of choosing your health. Keep the streak stronger than the momentary urge.
effects: Your airways are getting a break from irritants.
Your smoke-free identity is becoming more familiar.

milestones.title: Day 11: Notice the wins
milestones.message: Notice what you gain: time, breath, money, and control. These are real results even when a craving is loud.
effects: Your body continues adjusting to no nicotine.
Cravings often become shorter and more predictable with practice.

milestones.title: Day 12: Train the pause
milestones.message: Pause before reacting today. Ten slow breaths can create enough space for the healthier choice.
effects: Avoiding smoke supports circulation and breathing.
Your recovery habits are becoming stronger.

milestones.title: Day 13: Nearly two weeks
milestones.message: You are one day from two weeks. The goal is simple: do not trade lasting progress for a passing craving.
effects: Your lungs continue clearing and recovering.
Your body is benefiting from every smoke-free day.

milestones.title: Day 14: Two weeks complete
milestones.message: Two weeks smoke-free. This is a pattern now, and your fitness goal has a stronger foundation.
effects: Circulation and lung function can begin to improve.
Exercise may feel easier than when you smoked.

milestones.title: Day 15: Halfway to three weeks
milestones.message: You have crossed two weeks. Keep showing up for the person who wants better health and stronger gym performance.
effects: Your heart and lungs continue recovering.
Your stamina can improve as smoke exposure stays away.

milestones.title: Day 16: Make it automatic
milestones.message: Every time you refuse a trigger, the smoke-free response becomes easier to reach next time.
effects: Your brain is learning new responses to old cues.
Your breathing gets more protection during activity.

milestones.title: Day 17: Stronger than the urge
milestones.message: An urge is a signal, not an instruction. You are allowed to let it pass while keeping your goal.
effects: Smoke-free time continues supporting your recovery.
Your daily energy can be used for movement instead of recovery from smoke.

milestones.title: Day 18: Keep your reason close
milestones.message: Remember why you started: a healthier life, better training, and control over your choices.
effects: Your circulation continues benefiting from not smoking.
Your body is building more smoke-free recovery time.

milestones.title: Day 19: One more clean day
milestones.message: You do not need perfect motivation. You need one more smoke-free decision, then another.
effects: Your lungs continue avoiding new irritation.
Handling cravings is becoming a practiced skill.

milestones.title: Day 20: Twenty days strong
milestones.message: Twenty days is meaningful progress. Protect it with the same patience you use for your fitness goals.
effects: Your body continues repairing itself.
Staying smoke-free supports stamina and recovery over time.

milestones.title: Day 21: Three weeks complete
milestones.message: Three weeks complete. You are proving that your routine can be designed around health instead of smoking.
effects: New habits become easier to repeat with consistency.
Your lungs and circulation continue to benefit.

milestones.title: Day 22: Keep the streak alive
milestones.message: The next craving is only a moment. Your progress is much bigger than that moment.
effects: Your smoke-free coping plan gets stronger with every use.
Your workouts benefit from avoiding smoke exposure.

milestones.title: Day 23: Your body is working with you
milestones.message: You are giving your body the conditions it needs to recover. Keep choosing the version of you who trains and lives freely.
effects: Breathing and circulation can continue improving.
Your body is no longer receiving new smoke toxins.

milestones.title: Day 24: Almost one month
milestones.message: You are approaching one month. A craving cannot erase twenty-four days of courage.
effects: Your smoke-free routine is becoming established.
Coughing or breathlessness may decrease for some people.

milestones.title: Day 25: Keep your promise
milestones.message: Twenty-five days complete. Keep the promise you made to your health one hour at a time.
effects: Your lungs continue clearing mucus and recovering defenses.
Physical activity can feel more comfortable over time.

milestones.title: Day 26: One choice at a time
milestones.message: You are close to a month. If today feels hard, shrink the task: delay, breathe, move, repeat.
effects: Cravings can become less frequent with continued abstinence.
Your heart and lungs continue getting smoke-free time.

milestones.title: Day 27: Your progress is visible
milestones.message: Twenty-seven days of evidence is stronger than one difficult moment. Stay with the evidence.
effects: Your exercise capacity may gradually improve.
Avoiding smoke protects your recovery between workouts.

milestones.title: Day 28: Four weeks complete
milestones.message: Four weeks smoke-free. You have built a month of healthier decisions and a stronger platform for your goals.
effects: Coughing and shortness of breath may decrease.
Your lungs continue recovering from smoke exposure.

milestones.title: Day 29: Tomorrow is a milestone
milestones.message: One day before a full month. Finish this stretch by choosing the next healthy action, not the old habit.
effects: Your body continues benefiting from no new smoke.
Your smoke-free routine is becoming normal.

milestones.title: Day 30: One month complete
milestones.message: One month smoke-free. This is no longer only an intention; it is a pattern you have practiced.
effects: Coughing and shortness of breath may decrease.
Your lungs continue clearing mucus and recovering defenses.

milestones.title: Day 31: Beyond the first month
milestones.message: You made it past one month. Keep building a life where gym progress and clean breathing come first.
effects: Your circulation and lung function can continue improving.
Your body keeps gaining recovery time.

milestones.title: Day 32: Keep moving forward
milestones.message: A strong future is built from ordinary days like today. Keep your next decision smoke-free.
effects: Your lungs continue healing without new exposure.
Your stamina may benefit from staying smoke-free.

milestones.title: Day 33: Cravings do not define you
milestones.message: You can feel a craving and still be someone who does not smoke. Both things can be true for a moment.
effects: Your brain continues learning new responses to triggers.
Your heart and lungs continue benefiting.

milestones.title: Day 34: Protect your training
milestones.message: Your fitness progress deserves protection. Every smoke-free day supports the energy you bring to the gym.
effects: Avoiding smoke supports breathing during exercise.
Recovery continues with no new smoke exposure.

milestones.title: Day 35: Five weeks strong
milestones.message: Five weeks complete. You have already handled dozens of moments that could have pulled you back.
effects: Your smoke-free coping skills are well practiced.
Circulation and lung recovery can continue over time.

milestones.title: Day 36: Keep your identity
milestones.message: You are building a clear identity: someone who protects their health even when the easy choice is familiar.
effects: Your body continues adapting to life without nicotine.
Your activity can benefit from improved breathing over time.

milestones.title: Day 37: Almost six weeks
milestones.message: You are close to six weeks. Stay focused on what you gain every day you do not smoke.
effects: Your lungs continue their repair process.
Your triggers can lose power as you meet them smoke-free.

milestones.title: Day 38: Keep your future strong
milestones.message: The future version of you is being built right now. Give that person one more smoke-free day.
effects: Your heart and lungs continue benefiting from abstinence.
Your endurance goals have more room to grow.

milestones.title: Day 39: One day from forty
milestones.message: You are one day away from forty days. Do not negotiate with the old habit tonight; protect the milestone you earned.
effects: Your smoke-free routine is deeply established.
Your body continues recovering without new smoke exposure.

milestones.title: Day 40: A crucial victory
milestones.message: Forty days smoke-free. You have crossed the crucial first stretch and built real proof that you can live, train, and recover without smoking.
effects: Your circulation and lung function can continue improving.
Your confidence and fitness routine now have forty days of momentum.

milestones.title: 90 days complete
milestones.message: Three months smoke-free. That is a powerful investment in your future health.
effects: Circulation and lung function can show meaningful improvement.
Physical activity may feel easier than when you smoked.

milestones.title: One year complete
milestones.message: One year smoke-free. You changed your life one decision at a time.
effects: Your risk of coronary heart disease is about half that of someone who continues to smoke.
You have created a full year of evidence that you can keep going.
